name: independent-macos-computer-use
description: Independent macOS computer use through persistent JavaScript, cua app objects and a smooth nonactivating agent cursor.

interface.longDescription: Use a persistent cua JavaScript REPL to observe native app windows, capture screenshots, inspect Accessibility and OCR, and operate in background with a visible independent cursor. Normal macOS permissions required; app compatibility varies.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect a macOS app window and help me complete a desktop task.
